title: Cover conservative registered-check closing fallback branches and clean failed runs
outcome: Regression coverage distinguishes each conservative rejection in registered closing baselines and states that a failed clean committed-input run can supply a comparison.
acceptance: Add discriminating tests for source-attribution uncertainty, launch-only or unfinished commands, runtime-output cuts, watcher/outstanding-writer fences, authority-store and registration-root mismatches, and invalid measurement ordering; add a positive clean failed-run case.
